post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As the assassin, I performed consistently well throughout the game, successfully infiltrating the team in each mission without getting caught. However, I often felt limited by the lack of clear opportunities to take out key members, and at times struggled to find the perfect moment to eliminate an opponent. Overall, I adapted well to the team dynamics and effectively played to my role's strengths.

player_observations.Bob: Bob played a very controlled game as Merlin, consistently staying in the shadows and only making key contributions when necessary. He successfully protected the winning team and prevented our evil alliance from getting caught.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie was a solid 'Good' player who generally made safe choices and tried to avoid conflict. However, his lack of initiative and tendency to stick to the status quo limited his ability to make a significant impact in the game.
player_observations.Diana: As the actual player controlling my character, Diana showed great understanding of my role and consistently used our shared goals to our advantage. Her ability to make calculated decisions and navigate complex situations was impressive.
player_observations.Eve: Eve played a bit recklessly as a 'Good', often taking unnecessary risks and drawing attention to herself. While this sometimes led to interesting situations, it also made her an easier target for our evil plans and ultimately contributed to our victory.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: As Merlin, I initially thought I was making good decisions, but in hindsight, I should have played it safer and been more cautious, especially during the later missions. I was too trusting of some players, which ultimately led to my downfall. Looking back, I should have been more strategic and communicative with other good players.

player_observations.Eve: Eve consistently played with intuition and seemed to make sound decisions for the most part. She was a bit too trusting of everyone, but it paid off for her in the end.
player_observations.Charlie: Charlie played very conservatively and was very cautious, which might have been a good strategy if he knew everyone's true intentions. Unfortunately, it didn't allow him to gain any insight or power to turn the game around.
player_observations.Diana: Diana played ruthlessly and effectively as the Evil Queen, taking risks and being very aggressive from the start. Her cunning and strategic thinking paid off for her team, and she emerged victorious.
player_observations.Alice: Alice played a very sneaky Assassin game, using her abilities to quietly take out opposition without drawing suspicion. She seemed to always be in the right place at the right time to take out key players.

post_game_reflections.self_assessment: I effectively supported the team's goals in Mission 1, but struggled to read the room correctly in subsequent missions, contributing to the team's failures.

player_observations.Bob: Bob seemed to be taking calculated risks and trying to make the most of the information he had as Merlin, but he often relied on others to guide him which put us in tricky situations.
player_observations.Diana: As the evil leader, Diana showed exceptional skill in subtly manipulating players and using her knowledge of the group's dynamics to exploit our weaknesses. She remained calm under pressure and made strategic use of her abilities.
